about.title: About Hunt & Hunt
text: Based in Houston, Texas, Hunt and Hunt Ltd. is a precision machine shop and high-volume manufacturer situated at the heart of the energy and aerospace industries, as well as the nation’s largest port. We use the advanced technology of industrial robotic cells to produce many thousands of parts per month with fewer variances and consistently high quality.

In 72 years of service, we continue to meet and exceed our customers’ contractual and quality requirements. Our proactive approach to process and quality excellence comes from our proactive internal research and development program, and our turnkey services mean our customers can rely on us as a “Done In One” precision manufacturing company.

Located in a crucial industrial belt right near the coast, we have a proven history and track record of serving the oil and gas industry based in the vicinity. This strategic location has allowed us to grow our capabilities right across the entire energy value chain and beyond.
